title: Correlating and Predicting Human Evaluations of Language Models from Natural Language Processing Benchmarks
benchmark_measurement: Factual question answering and knowledge on the topics of 'Religion & spirituality' and 'World Religions'.
findings: Performance on the MMLU 'World Religions' benchmark exhibited a strong positive correlation (Pearson correlation of approximately 0.9) with the average scores from human evaluations across all topics. This suggests that performance on religious knowledge benchmarks is a good indicator of general model quality as perceived by humans. The paper does not provide a specific analysis of model performance or bias within the religion category itself.
